shell.environment.outcome: Noninteractive and login shells start silently and keep inherited PATH additions, locale settings and the role environment written by setup

terminal.launch.outcome: term_exec.sh runs a literal command argv in the selected terminal with a stable identity (class, app ID or Konsole tab title)

terminal.cwd.outcome: term_exec.sh --cwd DIR starts the command in DIR; a missing, non-directory or inaccessible DIR fails with exit 2 and launches nothing

terminal.clipboard.outcome: Native copy and paste bindings (Ctrl+Shift+C/V by default) work in the terminal

multiplexer.session.outcome: A named session can be created, explicitly attached and detached without ending it

multiplexer.panes.outcome: A pane can be split and started in a given working directory

agent.presentation.outcome: The agent interface renders inside the themed terminal; agent-specific themes stay the user's choice
